name: Richard RJ" Lennox"
occupation: Educator (25-plus years, including eight years in school administration); later work in a family business
background: Richard “R.J.” Lennox ran as a Republican for House District 46 in 2022. In his 2022 voter-guide statement he said he had spent more than 25 years in education, including the most recent eight years at the administrative level working with students, parents, staff, and an administrative team, and that he had more recently been working for a family business.
